title: Woman in Garden by Lily Pond, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1930s black and white snapshot featuring a young woman standing on a stone pathway by a pond filled with water lilies. She is wearing 1930s fashion including a wide-collared jacket or blouse, a belted skirt, and two-tone spectator shoes. The backdrop is rich with lush trees and flowering garden plants.
